name: delivery-surface-backlog
description: The Backlog desktop app as a run surface: forwards the lifecycle operations to the app's MCP endpoint with its bearer token and passes Backlog's answers through unchanged. Needs the app open with its MCP server on.

tools.name: open_dashboard
tools.description: Bring Backlog's Sessions pane forward, or answer unavailable when Backlog is closed or not set up.

tools.name: start_run
tools.description: Forwarded to Backlog: start a run, or reattach to the one under way.

tools.name: record_prompt
tools.description: Forwarded to Backlog: record a prompt in the run's history.

tools.name: set_run_context
tools.description: Forwarded to Backlog: persist the change kind, the approval decision, and the handoff marker.

tools.name: update_stage
tools.description: Forwarded to Backlog: move one stage.

tools.name: finish_run
tools.description: Forwarded to Backlog: close a run.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: Forwarded to Backlog: the runs this worktree can account for.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Forwarded to Backlog: one run, by id.
